title: Smoky Kenyan Braai Steak
description: A classic Kenyan braai recipe with smoky flavors, perfect for a relaxing Sunday dinner.

ingredients.name: Lazy Sunday Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Mix of paprika, coriander, and cumin

instructions: Preheat your braai or grill to medium-high heat.
Season the flank steak with salt and black pepper.
Brush the coconut oil onto the steak.
Grill the steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with Lazy Sunday Spice Blend sprinkled on top and a side of Kenyan Braai Sauce.
